primary_sql_diagnosis.root_cause: Keeping unique row_id inside SELECT DISTINCT prevents removal of otherwise identical highest-revision rows
additional_errors: Conflict counts used rows rather than unique invoice identities
Negative amounts were separated as negative rather than included in the required missing_amount category
primary_sql_diagnosis.original_sql: WITH inv AS (SELECT invoice_id, MAX(revision) AS mr FROM invoices GROUP BY invoice_id), latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.row_id, i.invoice_id, i.revision, i.department, i.issued_year, i.due_date, i.amount_cents, i.status, i.currency FROM invoices i JOIN inv m ON i.invoice_id=m.invoice_id AND i.revision=m.mr), latest_content AS (SELECT DISTINCT department, issued_year, due_date, amount_cents, status, currency FROM latest), latest_cnt AS (SELECT invoice_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM latest GROUP BY invoice_id), inv2 AS (SELECT l.invoice_id, l.department, l.issued_year, l.due_date, l.amount_cents, CASE WHEN lc.c>1 THEN 'conflict' WHEN l.status<>'posted' THEN 'non_posted' WHEN l.currency<>'CNY' THEN 'non_cny' WHEN l.amount_cents IS NULL THEN 'missing_amount' WHEN l.amount_cents<0 THEN 'negative' ELSE 'eligible' END AS cls FROM latest l JOIN latest_cnt lc ON l.invoice_id=lc.invoice_id JOIN latest_content lc2 ON lc2.department=l.department AND lc2.issued_year=l.issued_year AND lc2.due_date=l.due_date AND ((lc2.amount_cents=l.amount_cents) OR (lc2.amount_cents IS NULL AND l.amount_cents IS NULL)) AND lc2.status=l.status AND lc2.currency=l.currency), eligible AS (SELECT invoice_id, department, issued_year, due_date, amount_cents FROM inv2 WHERE cls='eligible'), pc AS (SELECT DISTINCT event_id, invoice_id, paid_on, amount_cents, status, currency FROM payments), pc_cnt AS (SELECT event_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM pc GROUP BY event_id), pay AS (SELECT pc.invoice_id, SUM(pc.amount_cents) AS paid FROM pc JOIN pc_cnt cc ON pc.event_id=cc.event_id JOIN eligible e ON pc.invoice_id=e.invoice_id WHERE cc.c=1 AND pc.status='settled' AND pc.currency='CNY' AND pc.paid_on<='2026-09-30' GROUP BY pc.invoice_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS inv_cnt, SUM(e.amount_cents) AS recv, SUM(COALESCE(p.paid,0)) AS applied, SUM(e.amount_cents-COALESCE(p.paid,0)) AS bal FROM eligible e LEFT JOIN pay p ON e.invoice_id=p.invoice_id
